sidebar.errorDescription: Make sure the local service and database are running, then retry.
sidebar.emptyDescription: Your first Skill testing workbench will appear here after it is created.

hero.eyebrow: Skill version and test evidence workbench
hero.title: Create a Skill testing workbench
hero.description: Create an initial candidate from a real Skill source, then keep improvements, test inputs, execution evidence, and formal versions in one long-lived workbench.

setup.title: Initial candidate setup
setup.description: After you select a Skill source, the server validates paths and resource limits again before atomically saving a candidate for testing.

name.title: Name the workbench
name.description: Give this Skill's long-lived version and testing boundary a clear name.

source.title: Select Skill source
source.description: Choose a complete Skill folder or import a ZIP archive used only for initial creation.

validate.title: Validate and manifest
validate.description: The server checks paths, sizes, and conflicts, then calculates SHA-256 for every file.

publish.title: Save candidate atomically
publish.description: A ready Snapshot creates an open Draft and improvement cycle, without a formal version or default baseline.

localFirst.title: Local deployment data boundary
localFirst.description: Skill files are copied only into the self-hosted service's controlled data directory. Real absolute paths are not read and source files are never written back.

createDialog.title: Create Skill testing workbench
createDialog.description: This creates the workbench, a complete file Snapshot, an open Draft, and an improvement cycle without publishing V1.
createDialog.workbenchNamePlaceholder: For example: Invoice Review Skill Workbench
createDialog.workbenchNameHelp: One workbench manages one Skill over time. The name must be unique.
createDialog.sourceScope: ZIP is available only for initial creation

folder.label: Complete folder
folder.description: Preserve scripts, templates, images, references, and their directory structure.

zip.label: ZIP archive
zip.description: Safely extract a file tree instead of storing the ZIP as the Skill.

createDialog.dropHint: Click to browse or drop the source here.
createDialog.preparingSourceDescription: Large folders may take a moment. Please wait.
createDialog.uploadingSourceDescription: Transferring files, building the Manifest, and saving the initial candidate. Keep this window open.
createDialog.uploadPolicyUnavailable: The folder upload policy is unavailable. Close the dialog and try again.
createDialog.serverValidationNote: The browser summary is for confirmation only. The server revalidates paths, hashes, sizes, and ZIP safety rules.
createDialog.ignoredFolderFiles: {{count}} dependency, cache, or package file(s) were ignored by the server policy.

errors.sourceRequired: Choose a complete Skill folder or ZIP archive.
errors.folderSelectionRequired: Use “Choose Skill folder” to preserve relative paths. A normal multi-file drop cannot reliably restore the directory structure.
errors.folderPolicyUnavailable: The folder upload policy is not ready yet. Select the folder again in a moment.
errors.folderFilesIgnored: Every file in the selected folder was ignored by the upload policy.

createDialog.fileCountExceeded: The selected Skill source exceeds the server file-count limit. Reduce the file count or adjust the server upload configuration, then try again.
createDialog.unknownCreateError: Creation could not be completed. Check the local service and try again.

settingsDialog.title: Default runtime
settingsDialog.description: Configure the Endpoint URL, API Key, and Model ID used by new workbenches.

workspaceShell.localFirst: LOCAL-FIRST · data stays on this machine
workspaceShell.loadErrorDescription: Make sure the local service and database are running, then retry.

testCases.description: Manage Skill test inputs, expected results, and reusable test scenarios.

datasets.description: Organize data files, sample collections, and data versions referenced by test cases.

runs.description: Start test runs, track execution status, and inspect run evidence.

reports.description: Combine version directory differences, test points, run results, and version labels.

overview.description: The current content comes from a complete server-validated Snapshot. Save the working copy as an immutable version when you need it for testing, comparison, or record keeping.
overview.immutableVersionDescription: Formal version content and its Manifest remain immutable. Future changes must happen in a new improvement cycle.
overview.candidateContentTitle: The initial candidate is not a formal version.
overview.candidateContentDescription: Keep editing the working copy, then save it as an immutable version when you need it for testing, comparison, or record keeping.

dashboard.todoHint: Testing and publication arrive in a future iteration
dashboard.recentRunsHint: Run status, results, and completion times will appear here after testing is connected.
